records.name: validate:priority-citation-pages
records.risk_prevented: Prevents the 24 owner-specified citation page requirements from drifting behind generic registry validation.
records.existing_coverage_gap: The global citation validator proves universal structure but does not encode every page-specific heading, table row, callout, or prompt requirement from the approved scope.
overlap_analysis: Complements validate:citation-contract by enforcing the owner-approved exact requirements.
records.decision: Admitted to bind the 24 approved page fixes to executable validation.

records.name: validate:release-portability
records.risk_prevented: Prevents internal registry URLs, undeclared Python dependencies, browser-video dependencies, Node-version drift, and missing release-critical files from reaching the local updater.
records.existing_coverage_gap: Prior gates validated repository behavior but did not prove that a fresh operator machine could install and execute the packaged artifact without hidden container dependencies.
overlap_analysis: Complements repo and artifact validators by checking cross-environment dependency portability.
records.decision: Admitted after repeated local-updater failures exposed undeclared environment dependencies.

records.name: validate:agent-recommendations
records.risk_prevented: Prevents the complete BHPC agent recommendation set from drifting after implementation, including existing-page fixes, exact-query opportunity pages, and explicit low-relevance skips.
records.existing_coverage_gap: The universal citation contract proves common structure but does not encode the agent-specific sections, worked examples, competitor framing, exact query inventory, or skip decisions.
overlap_analysis: Complements validate:citation-contract and validate:priority-citation-pages with the broader agent recommendation inventory.
records.decision: Admitted to make the full agent recommendation dump executable and prevent partial implementation claims.

records.name: validate:page-admission
records.risk_prevented: Prevents thin, duplicate, query-colliding, unsupported, or schema-inconsistent manual and future programmatic pages from becoming indexable.
records.existing_coverage_gap: The universal citation validator proves common markup but does not prove distinct intent, unique artifacts, page-specific reasoning, health-adjacent safeguards, or bounded similarity across the manual reference set.
scope: future programmatic page admission reference set
overlap_analysis: Extends validate:citation-contract with page-level uniqueness, source, safety, and programmatic-admission requirements.
records.decision: Admitted as the page-quality gate for the manual reference set and future programmatic batches.

records.name: validate:rendered-schema-parity
records.risk_prevented: Prevents final rendered HTML from diverging from FAQ, HowTo, Breadcrumb, Article, author, date, image, canonical, and visible-content schema contracts after post-build processing.
records.existing_coverage_gap: Registry and source validators did not prove that the final packaged HTML preserved exact visible-content/schema parity after the citation post-build compiler ran.
scope: premium GEO authorship and freshness surfaces
overlap_analysis: Complements citation-contract and page-admission validation by inspecting the final rendered artifact rather than declarations.
records.decision: Admitted after final-output audit found blanket FAQ schema, missing HowTo output, and cross-domain schema drift invisible to prior source-level gates.

records.name: validate:workflow-contract
records.risk_prevented: Prevents GitHub Actions from bypassing canonical validation, invoking missing commands, using the wrong Node/runtime profile, losing provider credentials, or shipping workflow files that are absent from artifact parity.
records.existing_coverage_gap: Workflow admission previously proved only that YAML files existed. It did not validate command references, canonical gate ordering, mutation/push safety, memory constraints, credential placement, or packaging parity.
overlap_analysis: Complements validation-registry admission and release-portability by inspecting workflow behavior and references.
records.decision: Admitted after hostile release review found deploy and automation workflows could diverge from the newly expanded validation stack.
